scope: Bounded target-aware Yosys pass on the compiler-generated accelerator composed with PCIe/UberDDR3
interpretation: The full composed hierarchy is structurally valid, but applying generic process lowering to the PCIe/UberDDR3 shell and compiler core together did not reach memory legalization within the bounded observation. This does not establish a design or functional failure; it establishes that whole-composition generic lowering is not a viable fast-iteration gate.
decision: Keep the compiler and platform synthesis boundaries separate. Reuse the already completed compiler target-aware mapping frontier and the proven platform shell artifacts, then compose only at a mapped/netlist boundary rather than re-running generic proc over the complete shell.
next_gate: Produce a reproducible mapped compiler netlist artifact and connect it to the locked shell through an explicit boundary for bounded fit/timing screening.
